ticker_news.title: This AI Fund Offers 7.3% but the Trade-Off Is Too High
ticker_news.description: The article discusses the Virtus Artificial Intelligence & Technology Opportunities Fund (AIO), which offers a 7.3% yield but has a high valuation premium that makes it unattractive to buy currently. The fund has a strong portfolio and performance, but the author believes the premium is unsustainable and recommends waiting for a market correction to buy the fund at a better price.
ticker_news.author: Contrarian Outlook
keywords: Virtus Artificial Intelligence & Technology Opportunities Fund
